verdict.rationale: An Upserve user reports using LaunchDarkly multivariate flags to throttle agent data at 1MB/5MB/10MB per batch, a hands-on confirmation of non-boolean flags serving numeric-style values. First-party docs in the pack refer to flag 'variations' in rollouts and experiments but never list the supported value types. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of multivariate flag types, explicit evidence of string and JSON values, and evidence of dynamic configuration use beyond the single community anecdote.
